mentions.description: Booking and scheduling platform for therapists and salons, featuring an AI agent, a public booking page, and support for multiple staff. Currently in final polish ahead of launch.
mentions.problem: The author's girlfriend, a therapist, didn't like any of the booking/scheduling software she tried.
